pinescript:
method ssro(float src, array<float> stblsrc, int len) =>
    float ssr = src / stblsrc.sum()               // Source of the underlying divided by the sum of stablecoin sources
    (ssr - ta.sma(ssr, len)) / ta.stdev(ssr, len) // Z-Score Transformed
